state:
**Goal `performance-pass`, Stage 4 (the review) has its check green:** `bun nv scaling --areas --reviewed` prints `every area has a ladder and a review section`. `docs/perf/performance-review.md` has one section per area of `AREAS` (`tools/nv/cmd/scaling.ts:278`): what was read, the findings with their gap records, and what is bounded or fine. It has no `## floor` section yet, and old refusals have not been priced again.

**27 gap records owned by `performance-pass`** came out of the review (`bun nv owners --check` counts them as `live-goal-owned`). Only `nvs-syntax/an-elseif-chain-is-not-depth-guarded` was confirmed with a probe: 300 `elseif` arms overflow the debug compiler's stack, and `else if` is refused with `E0108` at 90. The rest say *from the Stage 4 review, not re-run* unless the session read the site. No ladder exists yet for any review finding.

**Still red:** `scaling --check` (the growing ladders `fmt/classes.nvs`, `lsp/classes.nvs`, `numbers/bigint-mul.nvs`, Stage 5). The review names the likely causes: `nvs-syntax/a-syntax-index-lookup-scans-every-node` for fmt, `nvs-lsp/the-index-copies-an-entrys-reads-into-every-file` and `nvs-lsp/unused-private-scans-every-occurrence` for lsp. `docs/perf/performance-pass.md` *Decisions for you* has one entry: a total deadline for the request head.

Rule: `rule:testing/member-perf-ledger`.
